THE SEAL · THE FORM PROVED, EVERY ROUTE WALLED, THE BIT DELIVERED

the transfer from the record; at

svg.text: At every host, the value of the host's frame carried from its record: the antecedent a theorem, the implication the whole content of global regularity. Supplied by
the act at premise grade; assumed nowhere in the kernel; one blowup refutes it.
